free_convection.scaling: (g / p_s)^(1/3), from 0.17 (g kappa^2 / (theta_v nu))^(1/3) with rho theta_v = p_s / R
free_convection.source: Miller, Beljaars and Palmer (1992), J. Climate 5, 418-434, eqs. (8) and (9)

evidence: Two-year GCM tests at 15 levels with the provisional longwave refit, one realization each from the design climate's year-19 restart carried onto the levels: the Betts-Miller baseline's exact flags with the lunar free-convection constant over water, and the mass-flux scheme with the boundary layer's starting speed. They are the first two years of a spin-up, so they show the direction and early size of each change and not a settled climate. The CM1 numbers are the settled boxes (the sea box's third lunar day, the land box's second); CM1's surface fluxes come from its own surface layer. The bit checks compare the GCM's own outputs and restarts; the offline tests are the scheme's Python copy on the runs' 3-day mean site columns.
reading_rule: stages[stage][run]: rain by quarter (sunrise-noon, noon-sunset, sunset-midnight, midnight-sunrise; mm/day, with the convective part) at the Near-side Sea's and the land box's cells; their evaporation (mm/day), latent and sensible heat (W/m2, upward) and the lowest level's wind (m/s), by quarter and over the lunar day; the sea site's upper air on the box's levels at upper_air_heights_km; near the ground the lowest 0.6 km (the 15-level bottom layer), the 1.16 km level, PlaSim's 2 m air (read from the 0.3 km level) and the ground, vapour as a mixing ratio; global: the yearly summaries' means, the convective share of the area-mean rain, evaporation and surface heat, and the top two levels (water in ppmv). cm1_sea: the sea box's lunar-day evaporation and its near-ground air by mass over 0-0.5 and 0-0.6 km. free_convection: the sea site's evaporation with each constant against CM1's, and the share of the baseline's excess over CM1 the lunar constant removes. criteria[stage]: the brief's (a) upper air at 41.8 and 55.8 km, the share of the baseline's gap to CM1 closed (at least half); (b) the sea's night at most 0.5 mm/day, evening at least two-thirds of CM1's, afternoon within half to one and a half times CM1's; (c) the land's afternoon nearer CM1's than the baseline's, its morning at least 1 mm/day; (d) the sea's lowest 0.6 km vapour no further from CM1's lowest 0.5 km than the baseline's; (e) the imbalance at the top of the air within 3 W/m2 of the baseline's; (f) the top two levels; and the stop rule, convection's share of the rain under 0.75. gcm_trigger_start: the surface parcel on the runs' 3-day mean site columns under the IFS's start and the boundary layer's; start_sensitivity: the share reaching cloud at fixed starting speeds and sub-cloud mixing; cm1_thermals_summary: CM1's vertical wind against its own w*.
